column1: # The repo-carried mutation controls (MEMNG-267), read by scripts/check-mutations.sh.
# expected_failed is the EXACT set of FAILED ids the module must report under that marker.
# Three probes, not one: the claim being COMMITTED before the work is a property with three
# separate consequences, and the flush takes all three away at once — the row is invisible to
# another connection while the work runs, the claiming session stays idle-in-transaction across
# it, and a claim that was only flushed does not survive an outcome write that fails.
# The disconnect branch discards what arrived: the disconnect probe, the race probe (its answer
# is the stale snapshot the early return hands back) and the spool unit test turn red; the
# zero-byte probe stays green because a cut with nothing in it was already a no-op.
# A borrowed capture date is written only when the file said NOTHING: dropping the capture_civil
# half of the guard lets img-manager overwrite an offset-less EXIF date and its provenance.
# The consensus rule (MEMNG-797) needs the place to agree as well as the second: dropping the GPS
# check lets two RAWs shot the same second in different places, or one with and one without GPS,
# elect a consensus and lend one of their locations to the export.
# The ingest door serves its allowlist and nothing else (trip pass P2): handing it the home-interface
# routes turns the exact runtime walk for the ingest role and the union probe red.
# An unset INGEST_SERVICE_TOKEN must admit nobody: without the fail-closed guard an empty bearer
# compares equal to the empty token.
# Overlapping completions of the same uploads join under the device lock: without the re-check
# there, the second one finds its uploads consumed and answers 409 instead of the shared receipt.
# A filing re-checks its batch is still open under the row lock: without it two racing filings of
# one batch both create a memo (the second through the idempotency replay) and both report filed.
# Only a FILED batch is acked: acking whatever settle finds would ack the batches home refused,
# and the ingest host would purge bytes nobody filed.
# The device feed carries the ingest host's activity figures only: a pull that copied its
# revoked_* back over home's would clear a revocation the ingest host has not applied yet.
# A cut download resumes where the partial file ends; without the Range header it starts over.
# create_guest_memo forwards moved_out so a rolled-back filing can put its originals back in
# staging; dropped, the files stay in the memo folder of a memo that never committed.
# The door's association file narrowed to single-segment pass paths (MEMNG-1085): back on the
# bare `/p/*` claim the app opens on the empty secret, a second segment, a trailing slash and the
# An upload body that stops sending must end at the idle bound and give its admission permit back
# (MEMNG-934). Without the bound every probe that stalls a body on an open connection waits out its
# margin with the PATCH still running.
# The guest door's PATCH bounds its body's idle waits too (MEMNG-1158): without it a guest body
# that stops sending keeps its device's body slot, and the one probe that stalls a guest body waits
# out its margin with the PATCH still running, the body silent from its first byte included.
# MEMNG-968: the never-linked sweep's _unfiled/ discriminator; dropped, migration-era (flat) and
# memo-folder orphans and every look-alike path are counted and reclaimed.
# MEMNG-968 r1: a staging hit records its checked digest on the session; dropped, the session
# clause never holds a row a real POST /api/uploads session staged onto.
# MEMNG-1190: the memo create and edit ask whether a COMMIT that raised landed before walking back;
# walked back regardless, a landed write loses its original and tiers, and so does an unknown one.
# MEMNG-1168: a standalone finalize that dedups onto a detached row restarts its detach instant;
# cleared for every caller again, the row matches neither sweep and the adoption tests see NULL.
